messages:
nora: quick ping from UX review — put up a tiny prototype for the compact min/max + SLO guardrail flow: https://figma.redwood/compact-slo-guard-v1

rafi: saw it. two small asks: 1) guardrail wording feels scary "enforced" -> can we soften? 2) keyboard flow for the compact spinner?

tessa: agree on the copy. propose: instead of "enforced" use "recommended guardrail" and tooltip: "Helps maintain the global SLO; may affect cost." Short label: "Guardrail" not "Enforced".

igor: keyboard: compact spinner needs standard stepper controls + direct input. Use `role=spinbutton` with `aria-valuemin`/`aria-valuemax`. Arrow keys change value, Home/End to min/max. Also ensure shift+arrow for larger increments.

a11y-bot: a11y note: when guardrail prevents a change, announce: `aria-live=assertive` "Change prevented: would breach SLO guardrail" and provide a short action link `Adjust SLO` that opens inline editor.

nora: product note: product prefers automatic clamp for tiny overages (<=1 GPU) but a confirmation modal when user requests a larger change. Copy for clamp toast: "Min adjusted to meet SLO guardrail (auto-clamped)". Thoughts?

rafi: auto-clamp is ok but the toast needs an undo affordance. Use a short snackbar with "Undo" and `aria-live=polite` message. Keep it under 6s.

tessa: microcopy suggestion for confirmation modal: title "Confirm override"; body "This override may reduce availability and increase cost. Estimated monthly change: +X%" CTA: "Override and apply"; secondary: "Cancel". For small overrides (<1 GPU) maybe CTA should read "Apply override" (less alarming).

igor: visual: guardrail pill color should avoid red alarm — go amber for warning and add an icon (exclamation) with accessible name. Provide text label too (e.g., "Guardrail: SLO 99.5%" ).

a11y-bot: ensure tick marks on SLO slider are keyboard accessible and each tick has `aria-label` like "99.5% target". Also include `aria-valuetext` for slider: "Global SLO target: 99.5% — may change cost by ~2%".

nora: cost preview: inline small badge next to min/max "Est +1.2%" — tooltip text "Estimated monthly cost change". Keep rounding to 1 decimal and explain assumptions in details panel.

rafi: implementation note: when clamping, send analytics: `min_auto_clamp` with pre/post values and reason 'slo_guardrail'. Also bubble an in-UI link "Why was this clamped?" that opens details.

tessa: keyboard UX: when spinner auto-clamps, move focus to an inline banner and make it focusable so keyboard users see the change. Banner should include undo.

igor: animation: respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for clamp and toast animations. Also ensure spinner has 44px touch target in compact mode.

a11y-bot: checklist to add to figma notes: 1) spinbutton semantics 2) live region messages for clamp/fail/undo 3) slider ticks & labels 4) color & icon alternatives 5) undo snackbar focus behavior 6) reduced motion handling.

nora: plan: update prototype with copy changes, add the aria snippets, and wire the undo snackbar behavior. I'll push v1.1 by tomorrow morning. @rafi can you confirm analytics payload? @igor can you validate keyboard examples?

rafi: will add analytics spec today.

igor: will run keyboard pass first thing AM.

nora: thanks — leaving a couple inline comments in Figma. :sparkles:
